title: Boost PFC Average Current Mode Tuning

sections.heading: Current loop
sections.text: Average-current-mode inner loop shapes the input current to follow the rectified line voltage reference. Crossover: f_ci ~ fsw/10. The current compensator is typically Type II (PI with lead) to cancel the boost inductor pole. The current reference is the multiplier output: V_err * |V_line|.

sections.heading: Voltage loop
sections.text: The voltage loop must be very slow to avoid distorting the current reference. Crossover: f_cv ~ 10-20Hz (well below 2*f_line). PI compensator with very low kp and ki. The 2*f_line ripple on the DC bus must not appear in the current reference — the low bandwidth naturally attenuates it.

sections.heading: Revision note
sections.text: If input current THD is high, check: (1) voltage-loop bandwidth is low enough, (2) feedforward of line voltage is accurate, (3) current-loop gain is sufficient at the line frequency. The current loop must track a 50/60Hz sinusoidal reference — it needs adequate bandwidth at the line frequency.
